newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps reaffirms Tandy debt rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps reaffirms Tandy debt rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it reaffirmed Tandy Corp's senior unsecured debt rating of Single-A-Minus and commercial paper rating of D-One-Minus.
The reaffirmation follows the company's announcement that it would sell its Incredible Universe superstores and close 19 Computer City stores.
Duff & Phelps said, however, it will continue to monitor Tandy's performance in the intensely competitive computer retail sector.
In November 1996, Duff & Phelps said a plan to stem the continued losses at Incredible Universe and Computer City was critical to maintaining Tandy's ratings.

Tandy's leverage and coverage ratios had weakened significantly as a result of the poor performances of Incredible Universe and Computer City as well as ongoing share repurchases, Duff & Phelps said. But after the restructuring, Tandy's credit protection measure should be improved and satisfactory for the current ratings.
